A.name: Lane A/B/C integrated
A.evidence: 8 lane commits cherry-picked in order onto verified base 09147b16; no conflicts; Lane C runtime diff = 0.

B.name: requirements derive only from trusted capability definition
B.evidence: EvidenceSurfaceRuntime resolves required_evidence exclusively via injected trusted capabilityLookup(capability_id); request carries no requirement data.

C.name: caller cannot override requirements
C.evidence: Strict request schema rejects every unknown key (requirements, verification_level, conflict_policy, ...); runtime test "rejects every caller-supplied authority key with EVIDENCE_INPUT_INVALID".

D.name: production runtime accepts no caller initial coverage
D.evidence: Request schema has no initial_coverage/coverage field; initial coverage is built from trusted providers + Lane A qualification + coverage builder; test "initial-coverage attack: caller fake coverage is rejected".

E.name: provider selection trusted/internal
E.evidence: Providers are selected only through EvidenceProviderRegistry.providersForClass; request schema rejects provider ids/objects; test "fake-provider attack: provider ids and provider objects are rejected from the request".

F.name: production clock trusted/internal
F.evidence: Clock injected via constructor (default system clock); request schema rejects now/checked_at; tests "future observed_at can never satisfy (trusted clock, never request time)" and CP6V-FUTURE_TIME-001..004.

G.name: subject bound to capability normalized inputs
G.evidence: CapabilityEvidenceSubjectResolverRegistry resolves subject_key from (capability_id, normalized_inputs); candidate subject must equal run subject (EVIDENCE_SUBJECT_MISMATCH otherwise).

H.name: cross-subject evidence blocked
H.evidence: Qualification rejects candidate.subject_key != requested subject; eligibility re-checks normalized-inputs digest + resolver output; test "cross-subject replay: different normalized inputs can never reuse a run"; CP6V-SUBJECT_MISMATCH-001..006.

I.name: provider class mismatch blocked
I.evidence: Qualification rejects candidates whose class is not declared by the provider or does not match the requested class; CP6V-CLASS_SPOOF-001..005, CP6V-PROVIDER_CAPABILITY-001/005.

J.name: verification escalation blocked
J.evidence: Candidate verification above provider max_verification_level is rejected (EVIDENCE_PROVIDER_VERIFICATION_ESCALATION); CP6V-VERIFICATION_ESCALATION-001..008.

K.name: future timestamp blocked
K.evidence: Qualification rejects observed_at > trusted now (future_observed_at); CP6V-FUTURE_TIME-001..004, CP6V-FRESHNESS-004/005.

L.name: mandatory missing/stale/unverified remain fail closed
L.evidence: assessEvidenceCoverage never satisfies missing/stale/unverified mandatory classes; CP6V-MISSING-001..006, CP6V-UNVERIFIED-001/003/004/005, CP6V-FRESHNESS-001/004..008.

M.name: undefined conflict policy remains reject
M.evidence: effectiveConflictPolicy defaults to reject; CP6V-CONFLICT_POLICY-005/006, CP6V-CONFLICT-010.

N.name: optional evidence never gates
N.evidence: Optional classes can never block or satisfy-by-absence; CP6V-OPTIONAL-004/005/006, CP6V-MISSING-004.

O.name: coverage includes every required class
O.evidence: buildEvidenceCoverage emits one entry per requirement class (schema enforces uniqueness); CP6V-CLASS_OMISSION-001..008.

P.name: evidence IDs unambiguous and core-generated
P.evidence: buildEvidenceId uses a length-prefixed UTF-8 tuple (4-byte big-endian lengths) + SHA-256; NUL/control chars rejected in every component; test "is unambiguous: (ab, c) and (a, bc) can never alias".

Q.name: all coverage IDs trace to qualified records
Q.evidence: EvidenceEligibilityService fails EVIDENCE_LINEAGE_MISSING for any referenced id (including conflict ids) absent from the server-owned QualifiedEvidenceStore; test "a digest-consistent forged guard record with fake evidence ids fails lineage".

R.name: guard run core-generated/server-owned
R.evidence: guard_run_id = crypto.randomUUID() at runtime; records live only in server-owned GuardRunStore; request schema rejects guard_run_id.

S.name: requirements/input/coverage digests validated
S.evidence: requirementsDigest, normalizedInputsDigest and coverageDigest (canonical JSON + SHA-256) are computed at run time and re-validated at eligibility.

T.name: only Guard action=proceed may materialize authoritative coverage
T.evidence: Eligibility throws EVIDENCE_GUARD_RUN_NOT_PROCEED for any non-proceed run; test "only proceed runs are eligible; block runs fail with NOT_PROCEED".

U.name: forged caller snapshot cannot obtain eligibility
U.evidence: Eligibility API accepts only guard_run_id/capability identity/normalized inputs; forged run ids and fake evidence ids fail; CP6V-EXECUTION_BYPASS-001.

V.name: fake requirements=[] cannot obtain eligibility
V.evidence: Request schema has no requirements field; requirements always come from the trusted capability; test "empty-requirements attack: capability with mandatory A+B can never proceed on requirements=[]".

W.name: fake initial coverage cannot obtain eligibility
W.evidence: See criterion D; eligibility never accepts a snapshot parameter.

X.name: same-class cross-scope replay cannot obtain eligibility
X.evidence: Inputs digest + subject resolver equality; test "cross-subject replay: different normalized inputs can never reuse a run" and "same-digest inputs cannot dodge the subject resolver check"; CP6V-REPLAY-004.

Y.name: capability policy change invalidates old run
Y.evidence: requirementsDigest(current required_evidence) must equal run requirements_digest else EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENTS_CHANGED; test "capability policy change (A+B -> A+B+C) invalidates old runs".

Z.name: no public provider/guard/coverage trust API
Z.evidence: No MCP/REST/Tauri/LLM route registers providers, uploads coverage or forges guard runs; evidence modules are brain-server-internal; CP6V-PROVIDER_IDENTITY-001/002, CP6V-EXECUTION_BYPASS-002.
